```{=html}
{{#.}}
<div class="card mb-3 h-100 showcase">
  <div class="grid">
    <div class="g-col-5">
      <img src="{{img}}" class="img-fluid rounded-start" alt="Screenshot of the {{name}} project">
    </div>
    <div class="g-col-7">
      <div class="card-body">
        <h5 class="card-title">{{name}}</h5>
        <h6 class="card-subtitle mb-2 text-muted">{{org}}</h6>
        <p class="card-text">{{description}}</p>
        <a href="{{url}}" class="card-link" target="_blank">Visit project <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
{{/.}}
```
